candidates.taskHardwareFit: SGLang prefill/decode disaggregation where a long cached prefix must be packed for DCP relayout; correctness depends on scheduler segmentation, page offsets, per-DCP-rank region capacity, and backend-specific transfer behavior.
materiality: A radix-cache hit can leave little prefill compute while the decode worker still needs a very long KV prefix, so the transfer can exceed pack buffers sized from the compute-chunk bound.

The predecessor can bypass bounded DCP packing for this cached-prefix case and fall back to per-token transfer; more importantly, the gather path previously checked total allocation without proving that one DCP rank could not overwrite an adjacent rank's packed region.
The successor publishes the page-aligned one-send capacity only for DCP-relayout peers, splits oversized sends while preserving offsets/final metadata, and adds a per-rank NIXL region-capacity check.
deduplication: No exact upstream revision or PR #40376 appears in the existing szl-frontier catalog, Waves A-M, or issue/PR search performed in this observation window.
Distinct from prior vLLM KV-offload/backpressure waves: this boundary is SGLang P/D disaggregation pack segmentation and per-DCP-rank transfer-region isolation.
Distinct from prior SGLang runtime role-switch governance: this does not qualify dynamic prefill/decode role switching or unsupported topologies.
authorsClaims: Upstream reports 75 CPU tests plus 11 subtests on the latest revision covering packing, NIXL basics, Mooncake batching and staging draft KV slots.
Upstream reports six NIXL Kimi Linear GPU acceptance tests and six Mooncake-over-TCP acceptance tests including a 65,536-token cached-prefix case.
Upstream reports large cached-prefix TTFT/throughput improvements on an 8x B200 NIXL setup after bounded segmentation.
disconfirmingEvidence: The latest peer-scoping/test changes were validated with CPU tests; upstream explicitly says the GPU matrix was not rerun after those final changes.
The Mooncake RDMA run hit transport retry-counter failures and was interrupted, so Mooncake-over-RDMA is not qualified by upstream evidence.

The reported performance and model accuracy use Kimi Linear 48B-A3B on 8x B200 and are upstream measurements, not SZL receipts or evidence for other models, page sizes, DCP widths, transports, or hardware.
candidates.baseline: Exact predecessor source parent 80da4432d085ed4d6166ef643d9fd2b829dbb0c5 with a warm prefill radix hit whose missing decode KV prefix exceeds the DCP pack capacity, including a case that crosses a per-rank packed-region boundary.
requiredEvidence: Bind the exact SGLang source/build/container and the exact NIXL or Mooncake backend revision actually exercised; transport families qualify independently.

Create a no-weight deterministic predecessor control where cached-prefix transfer length exceeds one DCP pack allocation and prove candidate segmentation never requests a segment above the published page-aligned limit.
Add a sentinel-backed per-rank packed-region fixture proving an oversized gather cannot modify the adjacent DCP rank's region; the predecessor or equivalent negative control must fail this boundary.

Exercise exact page boundaries, one-token-over-capacity, multiple segments, partial final pages, token/page offsets, cancellation, timeout, worker restart and final-segment-only state/metadata delivery.
Exercise mixed peers: DCP-relayout sends must be bounded while ordinary TP peers on the same prefill worker remain unsplit unless their own contract requires segmentation.
Verify scheduler send accounting and decode-prefix length are conserved across segmentation; no dropped, duplicated, reordered or stale KV page may be accepted.
Qualify NIXL and Mooncake TCP separately if already available; keep Mooncake RDMA UNQUALIFIED until a complete non-interrupted run proves correctness and cleanup on actual RDMA hardware.

If an already-available model/runtime is exercised, bind checkpoint/tokenizer/config/hardware identities and compare generated tokens/logprobs against a monolithic or otherwise independent reference before interpreting throughput.
Preserve the incumbent non-DCP or previously qualified transfer configuration as rollback; disable the candidate DCP path if region isolation, accounting or output parity fails.
candidates.boundedResources: Start with no-weight scheduler/pack/region fixtures in szl-forge. Use szl-gpu-bridge only for already-available accelerator/transport closure. New paid spend is zero.
candidates.rollback: Retain the incumbent qualified transfer topology/backend and disable DCP relayout or the candidate packed path if segmentation, region isolation, cleanup or output evidence fails.
